SLEEP-01 and 02 help explore context and conditions. REG-02 supports discussion of feelings and needs; here, explore pressure around rest without making a calming tool a requirement for sleep.
strings.איזה חלק בחרתי לספר למבוגר?: Which part did I choose to tell an adult?
strings.איזה מענה בחרתי כאשר הופיעה דאגה?: What response did I choose when worry appeared?
strings.איזה מענה נעים אוכל לבחור בלי הבטחת שינה: What comfortable response can I choose without a promise of sleep?
strings.איזה עניין מעשי ניתן לברר בזמן מתאים?: What practical issue can be addressed at a suitable time?
strings.איזה עניין עדיין ארצה לברר עם מישהו?: What issue would I still like to discuss with someone?
strings.איזו דאגה ארצה להזכיר לקראת מנוחה?: What worry would I like to mention before rest?
strings.איזו דאגה עולה סביב ניסיון להירדם?: What worry comes up when I try to fall asleep?
strings.איזו מחשבה מציקה ארצה לספר בקצרה?: What bothersome thought would I like to share briefly?
strings.איזו תגובה בחרתי לנסות הפעם?: What response did I choose to try this time?

strings.איזו תגובה עוזרת ואיזו מוסיפה לחץ?: Which response helps, and which adds pressure?

strings.אין כאן טיפול מלא בחרדה או בהפרעת שינה,: This is not a full treatment for anxiety or a sleep disorder, exposure, trauma processing, or instructions for breath holding. Do not require thoughts to disappear, ongoing body monitoring, or repeated clock checking. Increasing distress requires stopping and appropriate assessment.
strings.אין שמירה אוטומטית ואין שליחה לרשת. השתמ: Nothing is saved automatically or sent over the network. Use fictional information for review. If an answer does not fit, shorten it or save the complete answers as text and move them to a continuation page. Check print preview.
strings.אפשר להציע קריאה, זמן ושיחה לפי העדפה. ס: Offer reading support, time, and conversation according to preference. Choose help from another person together with the participant, respecting their privacy.
strings.אפשרו שיחה בקצב הרצוי והבחינו בין דאגה ל: Allow conversation at the person's preferred pace and distinguish worry from a medical or practical need. Do not attribute nighttime thoughts to age or expect the person to cope alone.
strings.באיזה מצב בחנתי את המענה שסוכם?: In what situation did I try the response we agreed on?
strings.באיזה ערב רציתי עזרה עם דאגה?: On which evening did I want help with a worry?
Check whether the response met the need and preserved choice. An unsuitable tool also provides useful information; thoughts do not have to disappear before moving forward.
strings.בחרו בדף לאחר הערכה מקצועית ובהסכמה. אפש: Choose this sheet following professional assessment and with consent. The person may skip questions, answer aloud, or choose another tool. This is proposed original material for review; it provides no score, diagnosis, or promise of an outcome.
strings.בחרו מענה אחד שהאדם מכיר ומסכים לו, או ת: Choose one familiar response the person agrees to, or practice the conversation only in the session. Any chosen record should be brief, without repeated nighttime monitoring. It is possible to stop at any point.
strings.בחרו מצב שהאדם מעוניין לבדוק. אין צורך ל: Choose a situation the person wants to explore. It need not be the hardest situation. Check that the question is understood and the wording fits the person; their account comes before the therapist's interpretation.
strings.בקשו תיאור קטן בלי לפרט תוכן מפחיד. מבוג: Ask for a brief description without details of frightening content. An adult offers predictable support; the child is not expected to calm down alone or stop thinking.
strings.בררו עומס חברתי ולימודי בלי לחייב שיתוף: Explore social and school demands without requiring details of the worry. Agree on when help is available and what remains private within the setting.
strings.גם תרגיל הרגעה יכול להפוך למבחן. אם האדם: Even a relaxation exercise can become a test. If the person repeatedly checks whether they are calm or asleep yet, simplify the response and explore the pressure instead of adding exercises.
strings.דאגה עשויה לשקף דרישה ממשית. בדקו זמינות: Worry may reflect a real demand. Explore available support and time to address it, not just a change in thinking. Do not postpone an urgent matter for the exercise.
Fictional example: Yael worries in the evening about a conversation the next day. She chooses to note one question to discuss with her therapist and stops trying to solve every possibility during rest.
strings.האם ההבחנה בין בירור לתמיכה הייתה מועילה: Was distinguishing practical action from support helpful?
strings.האם היא הורידה מאבק או הפכה לדרישה נוספת: Did it reduce the struggle or become another demand?
strings.האם היה משהו שרציתי להפסיק?: Was there anything I wanted to stop?
strings.האם הניסיון לבדוק או לפתור הכול מוסיף עו: Does trying to check or solve everything increase arousal?
strings.האם יכולתי לשנות אותו לפי רצוני?: Could I change it as I wished?
strings.האם נדרש לעצור, לפשט או לקבל עזרה אחרת?: Did I need to stop, simplify, or seek other help?

strings.הציעו שאלה אחת בכל פעם ומעט כתיבה. תיווך: Offer one question at a time with little writing. Adult support must not replace the child's own voice.
strings.הקישורים הבאים שימשו לרקע בלבד. השאלות ו: The following links were used for background only. Questions and adaptations were written afresh for the expansion plan; no questionnaire, scale, or protocol was copied. Adult sources do not validate the child versions. This material makes no claim about session count or treatment effectiveness.

strings.נבחר מצב אחד עם המטפל. אפשר לענות בכתב א: Choose one situation with your therapist. You can write or talk, skip a question, or stop.
strings.נדרשת סקירה נפרדת לכל גרסת גיל. אישור לג: Each age version needs its own review. Approval of one version does not automatically approve the others.
strings.סכמו מה הובן ומה נשאר פתוח. היעזרו ב־SES: Summarize what became clearer and what remains open. Use the existing SES-S01 and SES-S02 for the session framework. There is no need to repeat an assessment or plan already recorded.
strings.סכמו מראש מה משתפים ועם מי, ואת גבולות ה: Agree in advance what will be shared and with whom, and explain the privacy limits in this setting. Do not promise absolute confidentiality.
strings.עם מי אוכל לדבר על עניין שדורש בירור?: Who can I talk to about something that needs attention?
strings.קיימת רשומת סקירה נפרדת לכל גרסה: התאמת: Each version has a separate review record covering age suitability, originality, rights, and fictional filling. Reviewer and date fields remain blank until assigned. File checks or a code merge are not clinical approval. Clinical information stays only in the authorized setting, outside the code repository.
